_README: Platform-level recruit adapters config. One company = one line. Keys: beisen=<tenant> zhiye.com slug; moka=<org>/<siteId> (derived campus URL) or an object with explicit sites. Value is the canonical company name (string shorthand) or an object {name, host?, ignore_categories?, categories?, sites?}. Adding a line registers the company in qiuzhao.collector.p1_pipeline.REGISTRY via the platform module.
